    Property for sale in western cape, for sale south africa

    Buying a home is one of the biggest investment decisions you’ll ever make, and it helps to have the advice and guidance of experts in the field. If you’re house hunting, REMAX helps you realise your dreams by offering prime property for sale in the Western Cape. This province boasts a wide selection of real estate and is renowned for its beauty, history and rich cultural heritage.

    Cradled between the Atlantic and Indian oceans, which converge to create very pleasant climatic conditions, the Western Cape is a truly unique slice of South Africa. From white sandy beaches, Table Mountain and endemic fynbos to the Karoo, the wine lands, and the Garden Route, this area is rich and diverse.

    Real estate that’s up your street

    If you’re looking to buy property in the Western Cape, we’re here to assist you every step of the way. REMAX is the South African real estate authority, and our experienced agents strive to provide clients with reliable, current listings and invaluable advice.

    Those who buy houses and apartments in the Western Cape can look forward to:

    Your home awaits

    Let REMAX help you navigate the South African property market, we’re in a position to help you buy the most ideal house for sale in the Western Cape. At RE/MAX there’s a home for everyone – let us help you find yours.

    Our agents are also available to help you sell real estate. Click here to contact us today.

    • An Unparalleled Lifestyle – The province is generally known for its high standard of living and relaxed, diverse culture. Residents benefit from safe and efficient public transport, and a variety of activities for both young and old in the well kept community spaces that abound.
    • Financial Opportunities – Local and international property investors enjoy lucrative business revenue in the province, due to the large number of tourists who visit all year round. Houses can be converted into guesthouses and B&Bs to cater to the ever-growing demand for self-contained accommodation.
